It is unlocked at {{Coll|Zombie Slayer 7}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{coll|Zombie Slayer 7}} |A1 = Scythe Blade |B1 = Revenant Viscera, 64 |C1 = Reaper Falchion |A2 = |B2 = |C2 = Reaper Falchion |A3 = |B3 = |C3 = Reaper Falchion |Output = Reaper Scythe }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Reaper Scythe |rarity = l |damage = 333 |speed = 10 |item_ability_name = Raise Souls |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Monsters you kill using this item will drop their soul. You can click on their souls on the ground using this item to absorb them and then spawn them to fight by your side.

Mana cost is based on the power of the monsters you summon. Shift right-click to view and remove souls from this item. If your summoned monster dies the soul will be removed. |item_ability_cooldown = 1s |item_ability_max_souls = 3 }} {{Main|Necromancy}} The '''Reaper Scythe''' grants a chance to drop a mob's soul on kill. Clicking on their souls on the ground while holding a '''Reaper Scythe''' allows the player to absorb and spawn them. The '''Reaper Scythe'''{{'}}s {{AN|Raise Souls}} ability allows the player to summon collected souls at the cost of {{Stat|Mana}}, with the {{Stat|Mana}} cost increasing with the mob's level. The soul is removed upon the summoned mob's death. The following items will buff the '''Reaper Scythe''': * The {{Item|Reaper Mask}} allows the wearer to store and summon {{Green|2}} extra Necromancy mobs. * The {{Item|Ghoul Pet}}'s {{AN|Army of the Dead}} ability increases the amount of souls that the player can summon by {{Green|2}} and increases the chances of collecting a soul by {{Green|+20%}}. ** The {{Item|Ghoul Pet|rarity=Legendary}}'s {{AN|Reaper Soul}} reduces the {{Stat|Mana}} costs of summoning mobs by {{Green|30%}}, increases their damage by {{Green|+20%}}, and increases their health by {{Green|+100%}}. == Essence Crafting == {{Essence Crafting |200 |300 |400 |500 |600 |essence = Undead |type = weapon }} == Trivia == *Summoning a Necromancy mob will heal them back to full health. This can be used in [[Enderman Slayer]]: the {{MobSprite|Voidgloom Seraph}} despawns summoned mobs, allowing players to store mobs such as {{MobSprite|Wither Spectre}}s or {{MobSprite|Tank Zombie}}s to fight them. == Gallery == Reaper Scythe (in hand).png|In-hand model. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Reaper Scythe (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Reaper Scythe''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|2019/October 11|[[File:Reaper Scythe (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Reaper Scythe'''.}} {{History|2019/December 18|Mobs hit by the Zombies should not receive any invulnerability frame.|+33 Weapon Damage (from 300 to 333).}} {{History|0.9.4|Changed summoning mechanic to the newly introduced [[Necromancy]] mechanic.}} {{History|2025/Aug 5|'''Reaper Scythe''' can no longer be [[Dungeon Item|dungeonized]].|'''Reaper Scythe''' can once again be [[Dungeon Item|dungeonized]].}} {{History|0.23.4|'''Reaper Scythe''' can no longer be [[Dungeon Item|dungeonized]].}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Reaper Scythe (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Reaper Scythe''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Swords}} {{Nav/Slayer/Zombie}} [[Category:Melee Weapons]] [[Category:Necromancy]] [[Category:Scythes]]
